lessons.title: Expanded Noun Phrases: Describing Our Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use expanded noun phrases to describe local features.
success_criteria: I can add two adjectives to a noun.
I can write an expanded noun phrase.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a picture of the local area and brainstorm describing words.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model building expanded noun phrases (e.g. 'the busy, bright high street').
lessons.independent_task: Children write 3+ expanded noun phrases describing local features.
key_questions: What two adjectives could describe this place?
Can you build a noun phrase?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note grammar application — evidence for ENG.W3.
lessons.plenary: Share expanded noun phrases with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Describe a place near your home using an expanded noun phrase.

lessons.title: Counting in 2s, 5s and 10s to 100
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count in steps of 2, 5 and 10 up to 100.
success_criteria: I can count in 2s to 100.
I can count in 5s or 10s to 100.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting in multiples from Year 1.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model counting in 2s, 5s and 10s to 100 using a 100 square.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise counting in steps of 2, 5 and 10, identifying patterns on a 100 square.

differentiation.greater_depth: Count in 2s, 5s and 10s and spot the patterns on the 100 square

lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting in steps to 100 — evidence for MATHS.N1.

lessons.title: Our School and Its Surroundings
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe the human and physical features around the school.
success_criteria: I can name a human feature (building, road).
I can name a physical feature (tree, hill).
lessons.starter_activity: Look out of the window and name what's seen.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss the difference between human features (made by people) and physical features (natural).
lessons.independent_task: Children walk around the school grounds (or view photos) and record human and physical features.
key_questions: Is this a human or physical feature?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note geographical vocabulary application — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap human vs physical features found.
lessons.home_link: Spot human and physical features on your way home.

lessons.title: The History of Our School
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a fact about the history of their school.
success_criteria: I can say when the school was built (if known).
I can say one way it may have changed.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children know about their school's history.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Share known facts about the school's history (if available) or discuss how schools generally have changed.
lessons.independent_task: Children record a fact about the school's history or make a sensible prediction with reasoning.
key_questions: When do you think the school was built?
How might it have looked different?

differentiation.greater_depth: Ask a follow-up historical question about the school

lessons.assessment_notes: Note local history enquiry skill — evidence for HIST.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap what's known about the school's history.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member if they know about the school's history.

lessons.title: Writing About Our Local Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write descriptive sentences about the local area using expanded noun phrases.
success_criteria: I can write a sentence with an expanded noun phrase.
I can describe a local feature.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap expanded noun phrases from Monday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a descriptive sentence about the local area using an expanded noun phrase.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 sentences describing the local area.
key_questions: What can you describe about our local area?
Can you use an expanded noun phrase?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 4+ sentences with varied noun phrases

lessons.assessment_notes: Note grammar application in extended writing — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Describe your street or local area to your family.

lessons.title: Comparing Numbers to 100
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare and order numbers to 100 using <, > and =.
success_criteria: I can compare two numbers using < or >.
I can order 3+ numbers to 100.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce < and > symbols, modelling comparing numbers to 100.
lessons.independent_task: Children compare and order numbers to 100 using the correct symbols.

differentiation.greater_depth: Compare and order numbers to 100 with symbols confidently

lessons.assessment_notes: Record comparison skill using formal symbols — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Compare two numbers using < or > at home.

lessons.title: Using a Simple Map of Our Local Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use a simple map to identify local features.
success_criteria: I can find a feature on a local map.
I can use a map key.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple local map or street plan.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a map key and finding features on a simple local map.
lessons.independent_task: Children use a simple map key to identify features on a local area map.
resources_needed: Simple local area map with key
key_questions: Can you find the school on the map?

differentiation.greater_depth: Find 5+ features and describe their location relative to each other

lessons.assessment_notes: Note map-reading and key skill — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap features found on the map.
lessons.home_link: Look at a map of your area with your family.

lessons.title: Significant Local Places
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a significant place in the local area and why it matters.
success_criteria: I can name a significant local place.
I can say why it's important.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss well-known places in the local area.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes a place 'significant' (a war memorial, an old building, a park).
lessons.independent_task: Children choose a significant local place and record why it matters.
resources_needed: Local significant place pictures if available
lessons.assessment_notes: Note local history enquiry — evidence for HIST.2.
lessons.home_link: Ask your family about a significant place near your home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Local Area Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words related to the local area.
success_criteria: I can read local area words.
I can read a sentence about the local area.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to local-area-themed words (e.g. 'street', 'shop', 'park').
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading local area words over the week.

lessons.title: Measuring Distances in Our Local Area
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to measure and compare distances using standard units.
success_criteria: I can measure a distance using a metre stick/trundle wheel.
I can compare two distances.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce measuring with a metre stick or trundle wheel, modelling on the school grounds.
lessons.independent_task: Children measure distances around the school grounds using standard units, comparing results.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note introduction to standard unit measuring — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Measure a distance at home using a tape measure if available.

lessons.title: Aerial View of Our School
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to interpret a simple aerial photograph of the school.
success_criteria: I can identify a feature from above.
I can say how it looks different from ground level.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what 'aerial' means, looking at a bird's-eye view picture.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model interpreting an aerial photograph of the school, identifying features.
lessons.independent_task: Children identify features on an aerial photo of the school and compare to ground-level views.
resources_needed: Aerial photograph of the school (or similar)
key_questions: What can you see from above?
How is it different from what you see on the ground?

differentiation.greater_depth: Identify 5+ features and compare perspectives in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note aerial photograph interpretation skill — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Look at a map app's satellite view of your home area if possible.

lessons.title: Presenting a Local Area Fact
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to present a fact about the local area clearly.
success_criteria: I can share a fact about our local area.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's local area learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes a clear fact presentation.
lessons.independent_task: Children present a local area fact to a small group, answering a question.
resources_needed: Work from the week for reference
key_questions: Can you answer a question about it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Present unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language progress — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all the local area facts shared.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite local area fact with your family.

lessons.title: Local Area Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve addition/subtraction word problems using a local area context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a local area context (e.g. shops on a street).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve local-area-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record word problem solving skill extending to 100 — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a local area word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Compass Directions Around School
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use the four compass points to describe locations.
success_criteria: I can name the four compass points.
I can say what is north/south/east/west of a place.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap compass directions from Year 1 Week 28.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model using north, south, east and west to describe locations around the school.
lessons.independent_task: Children use compass directions to describe the location of features around the school.
resources_needed: Simple school map with compass rose
key_questions: What is north of the school?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record compass direction application — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Find north using a compass or app together.

lessons.title: Our Local Area Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about the local area.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's local area learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about the local area, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What features are in our local area?
Why might this place be important to people?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on local area facts you learned.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Comparing, Measuring
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, comparing and measuring skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can count in steps to 100.
I can compare numbers.
I can measure distance.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of counting in steps, comparing numbers, and measuring distance.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 2 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.N1/MEA.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting in steps over the weekend.

lessons.title: Our Local Area Topic Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about the local area learned this week.
success_criteria: I can name a feature of our local area.
I can say why a place is significant.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's history and geography learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss synthesising the week's learning about the local area.
lessons.independent_task: Contribute to a class 'Our Local Area' display combining maps, features, and significant places from the week.
key_questions: What have we learned about our local area?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for HIST.2/GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished 'Our Local Area' display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about your local area with your family.
